summary: Smoke test of n0ct.log blog. Backend + frontend end-to-end verified: auth (good/bad), site, posts (list, search, tag filter, single-slug, 404), TL;DR via Emergent LLM (fresh + cached), admin CRUD (create/update-with-slug-regeneration/delete), site update, boot sequence, home search/tag filter, post detail, TL;DR reveal, admin login flow, and admin dashboard listing.
passed: GET /api/posts/{slug} -> 200 for existing, 404 for unknown slug
POST /api/posts/{id}/tldr -> Claude-generated TL;DR ('cached':false), 2nd call returns cached:true
POST /api/admin/posts without token -> 401; with admin token -> 200 with auto-generated slug
PUT /api/admin/posts/{id} title change regenerates slug (smoke-test-post -> smoke-test-post-renamed) and updated_at moves
Frontend boot sequence (data-testid='boot-sequence') visible on first visit and dismisses; sessionStorage 'hack_booted' suppresses it on reload
Home: search-input filters 3 -> 1 for 'homelab'; filter-tag-nmap chip filters to 1 post; 7 tag chips + 3 post cards render
Post detail loads for slug; TL;DR box present; decrypt button calls backend and reveals tldr-content (178 chars)
Admin login: wrong password shows data-testid='login-error'; admin/admin123 navigates to /admin dashboard listing all 3 posts with edit/rm/new-post controls
notes: Post editor form (create/edit via UI submit) and delete-from-UI were not click-through tested end-to-end due to time budget, but the underlying admin CRUD APIs were fully exercised with an admin bearer token and the dashboard renders the correct posts and controls. Recommend the full testing agent cover the PostEditor UI flow next.
